title: 2023 年 12 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

units.task: 命题式作文，以给定首句开头，围绕"掌握基础知识对学科学习的重要性"展开论述，可举例、评论或结合个人经历，150-200词（不含首句）。
outline: 第一段：承接首句，指出基础知识是学科大厦的地基，缺乏基础则难以理解高阶内容，辅以具体学科实例说明。
第二段：进一步论证扎实的基础能培养学习自信和探索精神，结合个人学习经历展开，增强说服力。
第三段：总结全文，重申基础知识绝非无足轻重，呼吁学生重视基础，为学术追求奠定坚实根基。
units.sample: As is known to all, gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject. The reasons behind this claim are both intuitive and well-supported by evidence. To begin with, the basics of any discipline serve as the foundation upon which more complex concepts are built. Without a firm grasp of fundamental principles, students will inevitably struggle when confronted with advanced topics. For instance, a physics student who fails to understand Newton's laws of motion will find it nearly impossible to comprehend quantum mechanics or thermodynamics later on. Furthermore, a solid command of the basics fosters confidence and intellectual curiosity. When students thoroughly understand the core concepts, they are more likely to engage actively in class discussions, raise thought-provoking questions, and explore the subject in greater depth. My own experience in learning mathematics perfectly illustrates this point. It was only after I devoted considerable time to mastering basic algebra and calculus that I began to appreciate the elegance of higher-level mathematical theories. In conclusion, the basics are by no means trivial; rather, they constitute the cornerstone of academic excellence. Students who invest time and effort in building a strong foundation will undoubtedly reap the rewards in their future academic pursuits.

phrases.en: a sound knowledge of the basics
phrases.cn: 对基础知识的扎实掌握；sound 此处表示"全面的、牢固的"，常用于正式写作

phrases.en: serve as the foundation upon which...
phrases.cn: 充当……的根基；upon which 引导定语从句，使表达更为正式典雅

phrases.en: a firm grasp of fundamental principles
phrases.cn: 对基本原理的牢固掌握；firm grasp 比 good understanding 更地道
面临、遭遇；比 face 更正式，适合议论文语境
培养自信与求知欲；foster 比 develop/build 更学术化
积极参与课堂讨论；engage in 搭配正式，体现主动性
完美地说明了这一观点；用于引出个人经历或具体事例
强调句型"只有在……之后才……"，突出时间先后与因果关系
构成……的基石；constitute 比 be 更精确，cornerstone 比 basis 更形象
收获回报；固定搭配，常用于结尾升华

pitfalls: 首句为题目给定，许多考生遗漏或改写首句导致扣分
全文只谈空泛道理不举例，缺乏说服力，论证单薄
词汇重复严重，如反复使用important/basic而不替换同义表达
段落之间缺乏逻辑连接词，行文跳跃，影响连贯性
超出200词上限或不足150词下限，未审清题目字数要求

upgrades.plain: The basics are very important for learning.
upgrades.better: The basics of any discipline serve as the foundation upon which more complex concepts are built.
upgrades.note: 用介词定语从句替代简单形容词，句式更复杂，信息量更大

upgrades.plain: For example, if you don't learn basic physics, you can't learn hard physics.
upgrades.better: A physics student who fails to understand Newton's laws of motion will find it nearly impossible to comprehend quantum mechanics later on.
upgrades.note: 用具体学科术语替代模糊表述，例证更有说服力和画面感

upgrades.plain: After I studied basic math well, I could understand advanced math.
upgrades.better: It was only after I devoted considerable time to mastering basic algebra and calculus that I began to appreciate the elegance of higher-level mathematical theories.
upgrades.note: 使用强调句型与高级词汇，展现语言功底，同时逻辑更鲜明

upgrades.plain: In a word, basics are not unimportant.
upgrades.better: The basics are by no means trivial; rather, they constitute the cornerstone of academic excellence.
upgrades.note: by no means + 分号 + rather 转折，结构紧凑有力，避免双重否定歧义

upgrades.plain: Students should study the basics and they will do well.
upgrades.better: Students who invest time and effort in building a strong foundation will undoubtedly reap the rewards in their future academic pursuits.
upgrades.note: 定语从句嵌套动宾搭配，结尾收束有力且用词正式

band9: The basics of any discipline serve as the foundation upon which more complex concepts are built. ——任何学科的基础知识都是更复杂概念赖以建立的根基。upon which 定语从句为高分句式。

It was only after I devoted considerable time to mastering basic algebra and calculus that I began to appreciate the elegance of higher-level mathematical theories. ——只有在我花费大量时间掌握基础代数和微积分之后，我才开始领略高等数学理论的优美。强调句型 + 个人经历，论证有力。
The basics are by no means trivial; rather, they constitute the cornerstone of academic excellence. ——基础知识绝非无足轻重；相反，它们构成了学术卓越的基石。by no means + rather 转折，语言凝练。
Without a firm grasp of fundamental principles, students will inevitably struggle when confronted with advanced topics. ——如果没有对基本原理的牢固掌握，学生在面对高阶课题时必然会举步维艰。Without 引导的含蓄条件句，比 if not 更高级。

Students who invest time and effort in building a strong foundation will undoubtedly reap the rewards in their future academic pursuits. ——投入时间和精力夯实基础的学生，在未来的学术追求中定会收获丰厚回报。定语从句 + reap the rewards 搭配，适合结尾背诵。
